module: Registry of a level's "facilities": garages, gas stations, dealerships, computers, private sellers, delivery providers and dragstrips. Reads the section of these lists in `<level>/info.json` and in `<level>/facilities/*.facilities.json`, normalizes each entry (id, preview, sites file), then gives access to positions (doors, parking spots, zones), garage teleportation and POI generation (big map / gameplay markers). Global: freeroam_facilities.
usage:
local garage = freeroam_facilities.getGarage('mongarage')
local spots = freeroam_facilities.getParkingSpotsForFacility(garage)
for _, g in ipairs(freeroam_facilities.getFacilitiesByType('gasStation')) do print(g.id) end
notes: Types -> lists: garage/garages, gasStation/gasStations, dealership/dealerships, computer/computers, privateSeller/privateSellers, deliveryProvider/deliveryProviders, dragstrip/dragstrips.
Facilities are cached per level (facilitiesByLevel) and are therefore only read once per session.

Normalization: default id = "<folder><file>-<type>-<index>"; default preview 'defaultFacility.jpg' (looked up next to the file then in the level folder, otherwise /ui/images/noPreview.jpg); default sitesFile 'facilities.sites.json' (string or list); zoneNames and parkingSpotNames default to {}.

BUG: formatFacilityToRawPoi calls M[<clusterType>..'FormatFacility'](f, elements) and expects an element in return, but the functions zoneMarkerFormatFacility, walkingMarkerFormatFacility and vehicleTriggerFormatFacility return nothing (they insert directly into `elements`): `e` is always nil, so the defaults of facilityPoiDefaults are never applied through this path. For clusterType 'gasStationMarker' the function M.gasStationMarkerFormatFacility does not exist in this file (call error on nil).
BUG: in zoneMarkerFormatFacility, the error message uses `data.id` while `data` is not defined (nil global variable -> runtime error on failure).
Minor BUG: in getZonesForFacility, the "Missing Spot..." log message uses `v`, an undefined variable (prints nil) instead of zoneName.

Outside career (career_career.isActive() false), onGetRawPoiListForLevel only publishes dragstrips; dealerships and computers only in career. The dragstrip tutorial is looked up hardcoded on the 'west_coast_usa' level.
doors: list of pairs {sceneObjectName, ?, radius}; the default radius used is 6 m.

getFacilities.desc: Loads (cache) and returns all the facilities of a level, as a table of lists (garages, gasStations, dealerships, computers, privateSellers, deliveryProviders, dragstrips).

getFacility.desc: Looks up a facility by type and id in the current level; error log if the type is invalid or the id not found.

type.desc: garage, gasStation, dealership, computer, privateSeller, deliveryProvider or dragstrip.

getFacilitiesByType.desc: List of the facilities of a type for a level (current level by default).

getAverageDoorPositionForFacility.desc: Average of the positions of the scene objects listed in facility.doors; zero vec3 with an error log if there are none.

getClosestDoorPositionForFacility.desc: Position of the door closest to the camera (core_camera.getPosition).

getParkingSpotsForFacility.desc: Loads the facility's sites files (gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites) and returns the parking spots whose names are in facility.parkingSpotNames.

getZonesForFacility.desc: Same for the zones listed in facility.zoneNames.

getGaragePosRot.desc: Best parking spot (for the vehicle) of the garage whose id is poi.id.

teleportToGarage.desc: Teleports a vehicle to the garage (spawn.safeTeleport), resets the camera, emits onTeleportedToGarage(garageId, veh) and reframes the big map navigation if a route is active.

zoneMarkerFormatFacility.desc: Adds to `elements` a POI with a zone marker (zones, center = middle of the bounding box placed on the terrain, radius) and a big map marker with teleportation to the garage.

walkingMarkerFormatFacility.desc: Adds to `elements` a POI with a pedestrian marker (center of the doors, radius = max distance + door radius) and a big map marker.

vehicleTriggerFormatFacility.desc: Same as walkingMarkerFormatFacility but with a vehicleTrigger-type marker (dragstrips).

formatFacilityToRawPoi.desc: Tries to format a facility according to its default clusterType and to apply the facilityPoiDefaults defaults to it (clusterInBigMap, interactableInPlayMode, quickTravelAvailable...). See the bug in the notes.

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: Hook collecting a level's POIs: dealerships (except remotePurchaseOnly) and computers in career, dragstrips always.

onGetRawPoiListForTutorial.desc: Hook collecting the tutorial POIs: dragstrips with isTutorialForDragstrip on the west_coast_usa level.

onActivityAcceptGatherData.desc: Hook collecting the activities offered by a POI: card (icon, title, props, button) for garage (gameplay_garageMode.start), dealership (career_modules_vehicleShopping.openShop), computer (career_modules_computer.openMenu), dragstrip (rules or history screen via gameplay_drag_dragBridge). Stations are handled in gasStations.lua.
